drafted_from: tools/research-a-creator-or-topic/tool-rows.json (tool:list-a-channels-latest-videos), do-work/research-from-this-computer.mjs and sources.mjs, test/commands.test.mjs; the example was run here with the folder's stand-in yt-dlp
start_here: Say to your AI: "List the 5 latest videos of the channel @sourdough and tell me their titles and links." It runs the channel command on your computer with yt-dlp and reads the file it writes.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it asks yt-dlp for a channel's videos and writes them to one JSON file on your computer.
instructions: 1. Check that node and yt-dlp are installed (brew install yt-dlp) and clone the Workshop repository. No key is needed and nothing is sent to Trillion.
2. Name the channel as a link, a channel id (UC...) or a @handle. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:list-a-channels-latest-videos"}.

3. It runs: node trillion-workshop/tools/research-a-creator-or-topic/do-work/research-from-this-computer.mjs channel --channel @sourdough --limit 5 --out channel.json (30 videos when --limit is left out; --yt-dlp PATH when yt-dlp is not on the path).

4. Read the last line it prints, {"result": {source, subject_ref, listing_url, count, out}}, then channel.json for the items: item_id, title, duration, published, url and the first 500 characters of the description. A failure prints {"failed": {code, message}} with exit 2: bad-request, no-yt-dlp or no-listing (the site gave nothing; say so rather than guess).
5. For the words of one of the videos, run tool:read-a-videos-captions with its item_id.

worked_examples.title: The latest videos of a sourdough channel
worked_examples.given: From tools/research-a-creator-or-topic/test/commands.test.mjs (the channel test) and run here with the folder's stand-in yt-dlp (test/stand-in/yt-dlp), which answers two videos for https://www.youtube.com/@sourdough/videos: vid-aaa "Shaping a boule" and vid-bbb "Scoring tips", channel Sourdough Notes. The AI runs: node trillion-workshop/tools/research-a-creator-or-topic/do-work/research-from-this-computer.mjs channel --channel @sourdough --limit 5 --out channel.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"source":"Sourdough Notes","subject_ref":"@sourdough","listing_url":"https://www.youtube.com/@sourdough/videos","count":2,"out":"channel.json"}} and channel.json holds items with item_id vid-aaa (title "Shaping a boule", url https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vid-aaa, published 20301105) and vid-bbb (title "Scoring tips"). With no yt-dlp installed the last line is {"failed":{"code":"no-yt-dlp",...}} and the exit is 2.
